text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! After that good and long
swim, I feel
like doing some light partner
running! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hello, friends! If anyone fancies joining
me, be my
guest!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's so fast!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ngh, I can't keep up at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl races off effortlessly.

Compared to the other Umamusume, her
ability is
overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her speed really is coming close to
being at a
world-class level. As I watch
her familiar form
charging ahead...
Graaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Who's that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only one other Umamusume manages to
keep up
with Seeking the Pearl, and that
racer is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're...

Heh heh. ♪ Here comes the junior-year

luchadora!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's the one and only, El
Condor
Pasaaa!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you, El. Haha, that was some nice

footwork.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa is a cheerful, mask-wearing
Umamusume who was born
abroad and belongs to
the generation
after Seeking the Pearl's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she hasn't debuted yet, it's
rumored that she's set to become a
Phantom Bird, truly
making her a golden
fledgling at present.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl! To be honest, I've been watching
you from
the treetops, waiting for the
perfect moment to
join the fray!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then I finally spotted an opening and
dived in to
take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What? Oh, so you're the one who was
watching
me all this time! But why?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Why? Well, I mean, that's because, I... I!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I admire, revere, and respect you! I
really look up
to you for aiming for the
global stage!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll let me train with you this
summer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Looks like I've caught the
attention of
an eager little chick.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
El was the only one who was able to
keep up with
me, but what do you think,
Trainer? Should we let
her join us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if she is a little inexperienced, she
has
exceptional talent, so we decide to
spend the
summer training with her.
choice_data_list: All right, let's do it together.

text_block_list.name: Pearl and El
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Nice work, El! Even the sand is no match
for you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Naturalmente! There isn't a surface on
the earth
this golden rookie can't run on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, so it would seem. That said, the
real battle
begins now!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: What?! Argh! Pearl's so fast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although the gap in their abilities is
undeniable,
they both fight hard and
push each other to
greater heights.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Running so much with you this summer has allowed my latent talent to fully awaken!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Extraordinary, genius, divine! With this
new talent
I've acquired, victory is all
but guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
El, you're certainly very gifted.
However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't let it go to your head! You have to

remember to consider the feelings and
positions
of those less talented.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Many people are out there struggling to
do what
comes naturally to you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: People are... struggling?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Remember that an Umamusume's
value isn't measured by her talent. It's
measured by how far
she can get from
her starting line.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's measure of talent varies, and
it's never
a surprise when someone who's
very skilled or
powerful wins.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why the real contest is all about
your growth. You have to take pride in
how much you improve and how high
you fly compared to the base level of
talent you were born with.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Your story needs to move people's hearts—that's true strength.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And only Umamusume who can do that
have what
it takes to step onto the
world stage. Got that?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pearl...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué bueno! I understand you loud and
clear! If
not being able to do that means
I won't be able
to become like you...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll do it! No boasting, arrogance,
or
negligence! I'll show everyone that I
can soar
higher than anybody else!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's perfect. Chase after me with
that
determination in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Confident but never arrogant, Seeking
the Pearl
serves as a great role model for
El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Trainer. All this training has made
my
stomach eager for some food. I think
it's about
time we got something to eat.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh! How about we find some ingredients
and
have a barbecue? I came prepared!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
See, I just happen to have some Salsa de
la Vida
with me! All we need now is
some stuff to grill up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that's the super spicy death sauce,
right? It looks like it packs quite a
punch. Haha, it's the
perfect fit for a
summer barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What kind of ingredients should we
prepare for
the barbecue? What can we
get that's good for
the body?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mull over her question. If we're talking
 ingredients that can help fuel them
through the grueling summer heat during
camp, then I
suggest...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Foods foraged from the wild forest!
You're right!
The forest is brimming with
things that will fill us
with vitality!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! It's time to put up a good fight
against
nature's fearsome, fabulous
beasts!

text_block_list.name: Wild Boar
text_block_list.text: Snooort!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Bring it on, boar! I won't lose to
the likes
of you! That's becauuuse...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The forest fills me with energy! El, while
I'm
battling this guy, you head off and
collect some
mushrooms!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ándale! Follow me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to how fired up Seeking the
Pearl gets while in the forest, we're able
to go and harvest
mushrooms without
incident.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Rare and hard-to-harvest shellfish, huh?
Well,
pearls do grow inside oysters, so it
makes sense
that that's our best choice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All right, El! Let's go digging for
shellfish!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Peeearl! I tried to dig up this one
shellfish, but it
shot a stream of water at
me, and now I'm
completely soaked...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You have to do better than that, El! If
the
shellfish try to attack you with
water...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You have to hit them back a million
times harder!
It's a battle of attrition
when it comes to shellfish!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oooohohoho! Hohooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fierce shootout between Pearl and the
shellfish seems to go on for ages,
but eventually
Seeking the Pearl
emerges victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally,
it's time to taste the fruits of our
labors. After cooking the fresh
ingredients, we season them with super
spicy death sauce and dig in.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Gasp! How mind-boggling!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pearl! Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heaven... I saw heaven just now. Oh, I
might get
addicted to this.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Dig in, El! Let's make this summer a hot
one!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Arriba! Burn away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy a fiery meal doused with super
spicy
death sauce.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I had a really great time today.
El, make
sure you keep watching my
journey in real time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm going to conquer a
European G1
race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do it for myself, for
everyone
watching me, and also...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For the Umamusume who will follow in
my
footsteps. This is my promise as a
seeker, one
who never stops searching.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Si! I believe in you, Pearl!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain the first Umamusume from
Tracen
Academy to win a European G1
race will be none
other than you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl makes a vow under
the starry night sky, hoisting onto her
back the hopes and expectations of her
underclassman as she advances toward
the future.
